brief: Merino wool and tree-fiber sneakers, $100-ish. Machine-washable. Looking for comfort-first shoppers, any age really.

profile.business_summary: A DTC footwear brand selling machine-washable sneakers made from sustainable materials like Merino wool and tree-fiber, priced around $100, targeting comfort-focused consumers of all ages.

relevant_tags.why: Footwear is a major subcategory of apparel and shares similar shopper interest.
Made from eco-friendly materials like tree-fiber and Merino wool.
Comfort-first sneakers are primarily worn for casual everyday use.

note_signals.why: Direct competitor in the shoes category, meaning they will block this advertiser on their thank-you page.
Direct competitor in the shoes category, meaning they will block this advertiser on their thank-you page.
Older affluent audience that responds well to quality messaging and comfort.

profile.gate_reason: The product, price point, and core value propositions are clearly defined, allowing for immediate campaign planning.
clarifying_questions: Do you offer free shipping and returns on your $100 sneakers?

issues: Includes unsupported environmental claims ('renewable', 'lower footprint') that are not backed by the stated claims.
The copy is too generic and lacks the science-backed, evidence-based, or outcome-focused depth preferred by the Wellness Optimizer.
Includes unsupported physical/ergonomic claims ('support your stride').
Invents a specific price point ($100) and durability claims ('built to last', 'long-lasting') not supported by the stated claims.
Lacks the discount-forward, bundle, or review-focused elements preferred by this persona.
Includes the unsupported claim 'Sustainable' which is not present in the stated claims.

pricing.rationale: Pay per click (verifiable without trusting a pixel). Market price to win a page view on these hosts: $0.59-$0.80 per click (median $0.69), from the simulated auction against the other campaigns. 'balanced' bidding tries to win up to 60% of each host's page views; the planned bid per host is the price that wins its planned share.
pricing.tcpa_unlock: tCPA unlocks after conversion tracking is verified and 50 click-through conversions are recorded.
